# claude-code

A collection of personal Claude Code plugins.

## Installation

### From Claude Code (Recommended)

1. Add this repository as a marketplace:
   ```
   /plugin marketplace add eichisanden/claude-code
   ```

2. Install a plugin:
   ```
   /plugin install <plugin-name>@eichisanden/claude-code
   ```

3. Restart Claude Code to activate the plugin.

### Updating

To update the marketplace to the latest version:

```
/plugin marketplace update eichisanden-marketplace
```

### Manual Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/eichisanden/claude-code.git
```

Then in Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add ./claude-code
```

## Available Plugins

### domain-model-diagram

A skill that generates domain model diagrams in drawio XML format from source code. It analyzes Kotlin domain classes (`data class`, `sealed interface`, `enum class`, etc.) and visualizes entity definitions, relationships, and state transitions.

#### Prerequisites

- [drawio MCP Server](https://github.com/pash1986/drawio-mcp-server) must be configured

#### Features

- Automatic analysis of Kotlin domain classes (entities, value objects, enums)
- Auto-detection of entity relationships (one-to-one, one-to-many, references)
- State transition visualization via sealed interfaces
- Consistent XML output following the drawio style guide

```
/plugin install domain-model-diagram@eichisanden/claude-code
```
